title: 老城修表铺
logline: 大学生林小满携奶奶遗表寻修表匠贺师傅修理，在拆表讲述中读懂祖辈未诉尽的牵挂。

shots.visual: A young woman in a cream knit cardigan and plaid skirt, eyes red and swollen, walks into an old watch repair shop and places a worn vintage women's watch on the wooden workbench.

lines.en: Master, could you please fix this watch?

shots.ttsDirection: 情绪怅然带忐忑，语速偏慢，气息轻缓下沉，重音落在「旧」字，像藏着没说出口的念想

shots.visual: The 58-year-old watchmaker with short graying hair, wearing a dark brown old vest and white shirt, with a single-eye magnifier over his right eye, picks up the watch and studies it gently.

lines.en: I fixed this watch thirty years ago.

shots.ttsDirection: 情绪沉稳带暖意，语速平缓，气息平稳，重音落在「常」字，像提起老熟人般自然

shots.narrationZh: 三十年前，它的主人常来铺里坐。
shots.narrationEn: Thirty years ago, its owner used to sit in this shop often.
shots.visual: The watchmaker uses fine tweezers to disassemble the watch on the workbench, tiny gears clinking softly under the green desk lamp.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪柔缓带追忆，语速稍慢，「三十年前」后轻顿，重音落在「常来」，气息轻软如翻旧相册

shots.narrationZh: 她说表停时，正等老伴送玫瑰。
shots.narrationEn: She said the watch stopped when she was waiting for her husband to bring her roses.
shots.visual: The young woman watches the watchmaker's steady hands at work, tears streaming down her face but her lips curving into a soft, wobbly smile.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪柔婉带动容，语速放缓，重音落在「等」「玫瑰」，气息轻颤，藏着没说出口的酸涩

shots.visual: The watchmaker holds a tiny polished gear up to the magnifying lamp, his hands completely still as he inspects it.

lines.en: She never got the roses, so the watch stopped.

shots.ttsDirection: 情绪专注带郑重，语速偏慢，气息平稳沉缓，像在碰易碎的旧念想

shots.narrationZh: 表修的不是时间，是没说完的话。
shots.narrationEn: What we repair is not time, but the unfinished words left behind.
shots.visual: The young woman nods, wiping her tears with the back of her hand, her eyes fixed on the scattered watch parts on the workbench.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪释然带暖意，语速稍缓，重音落在「不是时间」「没说完的话」，气息轻稳，似终于懂了藏在表里的心事

shots.narrationZh: 老城修表铺，留住想留的时光。
shots.narrationEn: Old City Watch Repair Shop: preserve the moments you want to keep.
shots.visual: The watchmaker hands the fully assembled, ticking watch back to the young woman, both of them sharing a soft, warm smile.
shots.ttsDirection: 情绪温暖收束，语速放缓，重音落在「留住」「想留的时光」，气息柔缓带余韵，像把旧时光轻轻递回手里
